text.card: A red giant 1,714 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.88 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,532 K at its surface.
